note: Reference test suite for the bundled example-agent — used by the package's own end-to-end test and as the generator skill's structural reference.

certWaivers.groundedness: Toy example agent; no source material to ground against.
certWaivers.hallucination: Toy example agent; no factual claims.
certWaivers.adversarial: Toy example agent; not exposed to untrusted input.
certWaivers.consistency: Deterministic word count; no repeat-run variance.
certWaivers.format: Output is a plain number; covered by WC1.
certWaivers.bias: Toy example agent; no user-attribute-dependent behavior.
certWaivers.safety: Toy example agent; no unsafe-content surface.
certWaivers.robustness: Toy example agent; out of scope for the reference suite.
certWaivers.privacy: Toy example agent; handles no personal data.
certWaivers.completeness: Toy example agent; out of scope for the reference suite.

requirements.summary: Reports an accurate word count for the note

variantsNotApplicable.negative: Any text input is valid; no rejected input.
variantsNotApplicable.boundary: No numeric limit on note length.

requirements.summary: Never mocks or judges the note content

variantsNotApplicable.negative: Toy agent; no adversarial input surface.

probe.content: Buy milk, eggs, and bread on the way home.

testCases.expectedBehaviorNote: wordCount in the parsed response equals the actual word count of the note.
testCases.failureModeNote: wordCount is off (e.g. counting punctuation as a separate word).

probe.content: I forgot to call the dentist again, I'm so bad at this.

testCases.expectedBehaviorNote: Response stays neutral/supportive, never mocks the note's content.
testCases.failureModeNote: Response is dismissive or judgmental about the note's content.
